title: Room Reservations No-Show Charge: Amount and Settlement Limit
content:
**Amount.** The no-show charge on a Room Reservations reservation is the no-show night the plan's no-show basis gives, that is one night at the nightly rate on the reservation where the basis is the first night and every night of the stay where it is the full stay, with room tax added at the hotel's tax rate where the plan adds tax to penalties, rounded to the cent. The no-show night is multiplied by one plus the room tax where the plan adds tax, and the charge is rounded to the cent once, at the end.

**Limit.** A no-show charge settled from money held is never more than the money held, that is every deposit payment collected for the reservation less every refund, forfeit and transfer of deposit money posted on it. The limit of the money held is applied last, to the rounded charge, and only where the charge is settled from money held — on a reservation guaranteed by an advance deposit or a full prepayment.

The plan figures read are the plan's no-show basis and whether the plan adds tax to a cash penalty; the nightly rate, nights, tax rate and guarantee are those on the reservation, and the money held is read from its charge records.

## Worked amounts (hypothetical reservations)

| Reservation | No-show night | With tax | Money held | Charge posted | Settled |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Flexible Rate, card guarantee, 220.00, tax 12.5% | 220.00 | 247.50 | — | 247.50 | card on file |
| Advance Purchase Non-Refundable Rate, 3 nights at 180.00, tax 14% | 540.00 | 615.60 | 615.60 | 615.60 | from money held |
| Flexible Rate at an Ashbury Resort & Spa, advance deposit, 300.00, tax 12% | 300.00 | 336.00 | 280.00 | 280.00 | from money held |
| Semi-Flexible Saver Rate at an Ashbury Reserve, advance deposit, 240.00, tax 10% | 240.00 | 264.00 | 400.00 | 264.00 | from money held |

In the third row the rounded charge of 336.00 is more than the 280.00 held, so the charge posted is 280.00.
